name: Marblehead → Provincetown (overnight distance race)
note: Overnight passage SE across Massachusetts Bay into Cape Cod Bay. Not a daytime sea-breeze venue -> forecast is gradient wind + coastal land-breeze at the start + tidal current at the Race Point/P-town approach. The heavy WRF/LES sea-breeze stack is NOT the right tool here (no nocturnal thermal signal, corridor too long for a 111 m nest); this zone drives the gradient-model corridor briefing (corridor_forecast.py).
